stem:
The diagram shows Anvi's evening activity strip. Each block is 1 hour. Green is play, blue is study, orange is meal, grey is rest.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Study lasts 1 hour because study is one colour.
Study lasts 8 hours because the strip has 8 blocks.
Study lasts 3 hours because three blue blocks are study.
Play lasts 3 hours because play sits before study.

teacher.key_rationale: Duration is the count of blocks of that colour times 1 hour, so three blue study blocks are 3 hours. One colour is not one hour. The whole strip length is not study time. Play has two green blocks, not three from order alone.
teacher.figure_note: Added 8-block activity strip with play/study/meal/rest colours.
